# Pipe queries over the tests' tables, run by GoogleSQL's execute_query 2026.11.1 over the same
# rows: each query, its columns and their types, and its rows as the table mode prints them,
# sorted, or its error.
# Generated by scratch/projects/pipe-parser/queries/record_queries.py from cases_5c.txt.
DECLARE x INT64 DEFAULT 5; FROM t |> SELECT x	["x"]	[["1"], ["2"], ["3"]]
DECLARE y DEFAULT 'q'; FROM t |> SELECT x, y	["x", "y"]	[["1", "q"], ["2", "q"], ["3", "q"]]
DECLARE z INT64; FROM t |> SELECT z	["z"]	[["NULL"], ["NULL"], ["NULL"]]
DECLARE a, b INT64 DEFAULT 1; SET a = 7; FROM t |> SELECT a, b	["a", "b"]	[["7", "1"], ["7", "1"], ["7", "1"]]
DECLARE a INT64; SET a = 'q'	ERROR	Expected type INT64; found STRING
DECLARE a INT64 DEFAULT 1; DECLARE b DEFAULT a + 1; FROM t |> SELECT b	["b"]	[["2"], ["2"], ["2"]]
DECLARE a INT64 DEFAULT 2; FROM t |> ORDER BY x |> LIMIT a	["x", "s"]	[["1", "a"], ["2", "b"]]
DECLARE a, b INT64; SET (a, b) = (3, 4); FROM t |> SELECT a + b AS c	["c"]	[["7"], ["7"], ["7"]]
DECLARE n INT64 DEFAULT (FROM u |> AGGREGATE COUNT(*)); FROM t |> SELECT n	["n"]	[["3"], ["3"], ["3"]]
DECLARE f FLOAT64 DEFAULT 1; FROM t |> SELECT f	["f"]	[["1"], ["1"], ["1"]]
SET nope = 1	ERROR	Undeclared variable: nope
DECLARE a INT64 DEFAULT 1; DECLARE a INT64	ERROR	Variable 'a' redeclaration
DECLARE k INT64 DEFAULT 2; FROM t |> WHERE x >= k |> SELECT x	["x"]	[["2"], ["3"]]
CREATE TEMP TABLE w AS (FROM t |> WHERE x > 1); FROM w	["x", "s"]	[["2", "b"], ["3", "NULL"]]
CREATE TEMP TABLE w AS (FROM t |> WHERE x > 1); FROM u |> JOIN w USING (x) |> SELECT x, w.s	["x", "s"]	[["2", "b"], ["3", "NULL"]]
CREATE TEMP TABLE w AS (FROM t); CREATE TEMP TABLE w AS (FROM t)	ERROR	Table w already exists
CREATE TEMP FUNCTION f(x INT64) AS (x + 1); FROM t |> SELECT f(x) AS y	["y"]	[["2"], ["3"], ["4"]]
CREATE TEMP FUNCTION f(x INT64) RETURNS FLOAT64 AS (x / 2); FROM t |> SELECT f(x) AS y	["y"]	[["0.5"], ["1"], ["1.5"]]
CREATE TEMP FUNCTION g(v ANY TYPE) AS (v || v); FROM t |> SELECT g('ab') AS s, g([x]) AS a	["s", "a"]	[["abab", "[1, 1]"], ["abab", "[2, 2]"], ["abab", "[3, 3]"]]
CREATE TEMP FUNCTION f(x INT64) AS (x + 1); FROM t |> SELECT f('a')	ERROR	No matching signature for function f
CREATE TEMP FUNCTION f(x INT64) AS (x + 1); FROM t |> SELECT f(1, 2)	ERROR	No matching signature for function f
CREATE TEMP FUNCTION f(x INT64) AS (x + 1); FROM t |> SELECT f(x => 3) AS y	["y"]	[["4"], ["4"], ["4"]]
CREATE TEMP AGGREGATE FUNCTION h(v INT64, k INT64 NOT AGGREGATE) AS (SUM(v) * k); FROM t |> AGGREGATE h(x, 10) AS total	["total"]	[["60"]]
CREATE TEMP AGGREGATE FUNCTION h(v INT64) AS (SUM(v) * 2); FROM t |> SELECT h(x)	ERROR	Aggregate function h not allowed in pipe SELECT
CREATE TEMP FUNCTION f(x INT64) AS (y + 1)	ERROR	Unrecognized name: y
DECLARE lo INT64 DEFAULT 0; CREATE TEMP FUNCTION f(a INT64) AS (a + lo); FROM t |> SELECT f(x) AS y	["y"]	[["1"], ["2"], ["3"]]
DECLARE lo INT64 DEFAULT 0; CREATE TEMP FUNCTION f(a INT64) AS (a + lo); SET lo = 5; FROM t |> SELECT f(x) AS y	["y"]	[["6"], ["7"], ["8"]]
DECLARE x INT64 DEFAULT 10; CREATE TEMP FUNCTION f(x INT64) AS (x * 2); FROM t |> SELECT f(1) AS y	["y"]	[["2"], ["2"], ["2"]]
DECLARE k INT64 DEFAULT 10; CREATE TEMP AGGREGATE FUNCTION h(v INT64) AS (SUM(v) + k); FROM t |> AGGREGATE h(x) AS total	["total"]	[["16"]]
DECLARE k INT64 DEFAULT 2; CREATE TEMP TABLE FUNCTION g(n INT64) AS (FROM t |> WHERE x >= n + k); FROM g(0) |> SELECT x	["x"]	[["2"], ["3"]]
